culture.text: A young company founded in 2020 with about 48 people, mostly in real estate, operations and sales.
Staff often studied economics, business or real estate at Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, VU or Utrecht.
Its one open job here is a software engineering internship in Amsterdam.
